name: agentic-kit
description: Personal Claude Code marketplace. Hosts the cmux-swarm, motion-trace, design-eng, dor-dod, and flowlever plugins; the remaining loose skills ship as symlinks via install.sh.

plugins.name: cmux-swarm
plugins.description: Orchestrate a team of Claude Code agents in cmux (create-swarm) plus filtered code-check and visual-check skills and a cmux bootstrap command.

plugins.name: motion-trace
plugins.description: Review web animation as structured per-frame data (not video): easing, overshoot, prefers-reduced-motion accessibility, and real-runtime jank. MCP tools (discover/review/capture/diff) plus a motion-review skill.

plugins.name: design-eng
plugins.description: Design-engineering skills: ui-reverse-engineer (screenshot/URL → faithful reconstruction + design tokens), motion-system (design the motion layer — tokens, choreography, per-state transitions — inferred from taste or measured from video/URL), and figma-export (push tokens + components into Figma).

plugins.name: dor-dod
plugins.description: Specification & dev toolkit on the FZAG DXP Definition of Ready/Done: spec (author a story/bug/feature spec to the relevant DoR as markdown), check (audit any artifact against the matching DoR/DoD), and promote (publish a draft to an Azure DevOps work item or Confluence page). One shared source-of-truth checklist; works with or without MCP.

plugins.name: flowlever
plugins.description: Local review cockpit for specs and PR review/respond: a fingerprinted findings ledger that tracks issues across audit rounds, a guided review-flow stepper, exportable work orders, and UI-triggered jobs. Bundles a zero-dependency Node app plus /flowlever:* skills (audit, rework, brief, track, start, watch, pr-review, pr-respond).
